atoms.b: Tectonic plates roughly fit together and ((dance ++meet)) at points called plate boundaries.
There are three main types of plate ((separation ++boundary)) that can form.

instruction.text: Read the text and answer the questions.

atoms.text: Conservative plate boundaries form when two plates slide past each other in opposite directions.

At a constructive plate boundary, tectonic plates move apart, and the gap between them fills with magma. This magma cools when it reaches the surface and forms a new crust. This happens repeatedly as the plates continue to move.
Destructive plate boundaries are where two plates move towards each other. This causes one plate to be pushed up on top of the other, which is how mountain ranges form.

atoms.a: What happens at a conservative plate boundary?
b: three plates move towards each other

atoms.a: Which substance rises between the two plates at a constructive plate boundary?
What landforms are created by destructive plate boundaries?

instruction.text: Select the oceanic plate to find out more about destructive plate boundaries.

feedback.end: When an oceanic plate moves towards a continental plate, it is forced underneath and melts in the mantle. The area where this happens is called a subduction zone.

atoms.b: Volcanoes are very common around subduction zones. As the oceanic plate melts, ((rain ++magma)) rises up and breaks through the Earth’s surface.
Earthquakes are another natural disaster that happen as a result of tectonic plate movement. Intense plate movements cause the ground above to ((melt ++shake)).
